# Journalism Geo v1.0.23

> Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on wrangling geospatial data.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/README.md): Installation, examples and usage.

## API
- [GeoToBlenderFlatProjection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/type-aliases/GeoToBlenderFlatProjection.md): GeoToBlenderFlatProjection type alias
- [GeoToBlenderOptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/type-aliases/GeoToBlenderOptions.md): GeoToBlenderOptions type alias
- [GeoToBlenderPointFlatProjection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/type-aliases/GeoToBlenderPointFlatProjection.md): GeoToBlenderPointFlatProjection type alias
- [GeoToBlenderPointOptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/type-aliases/GeoToBlenderPointOptions.md): GeoToBlenderPointOptions type alias
- [GeoToBlenderPointProjection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/type-aliases/GeoToBlenderPointProjection.md): GeoToBlenderPointProjection type alias
- [GeoToBlenderProjection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/type-aliases/GeoToBlenderProjection.md): GeoToBlenderProjection type alias
- [distance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/distance.md): distance function
- [geoTo3D](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/geoTo3D.md): geoTo3D function
- [geoToBlender](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/geoToBlender.md): geoToBlender function
- [geoToBlenderPoint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/geoToBlenderPoint.md): geoToBlenderPoint function
- [getClosest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/getClosest.md): getClosest function
- [getGeoTiffDetails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/getGeoTiffDetails.md): getGeoTiffDetails function
- [getGeoTiffValues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/getGeoTiffValues.md): getGeoTiffValues function
- [styledLayerDescriptor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nshiab/journalism-geo/v1.0.23/docs/functions/styledLayerDescriptor.md): styledLayerDescriptor function
